title: potentiometer
description: Potentiometer / rheostat / trimmer component data — an ADJUSTABLE three-terminal resistive divider. A wiper splits one resistive track of constant total resistance into two sections whose values sum to totalResistance; where the wiper sits is a design-time free variable, not a datasheet fact. It is a separate RAS member and not a `resistor` because a potentiometer SATISFIES every field the fixed-resistor electrical block requires (resistance, tolerance, powerRating), so filing one as a resistor validates SILENTLY and quietly becomes wrong — nothing would record that the part is adjustable, has a third terminal, or has a taper. `resistance` deliberately does not exist here: the analogous field is `totalResistance`, so a fixed-resistor electrical block cannot be re-labelled into this schema. The presence of the 'potentiometer' field at the top level of an RAS document discriminates the device type — there is no deviceType property. ANGULAR QUANTITIES (mechanicalTravel, electricalTravel) ARE IN DEGREES, not radians — the documented unit exception for this schema; every other quantity is SI base (Ohm, W, V, A, metre, Celsius for temperatures, as elsewhere in RAS).

anyOf.description: A sourced part: carries its manufacturer + datasheet.
A pre-sourcing seed: an empty potentiometer object whose requirements live in the enclosing PEAS document's inputs.designRequirements (family-wide seed convention).

technology.title: potentiometerTechnology
technology.description: Resistive-element material of the track. 'cermet' — ceramic-metal thick film, the standard trimmer material. 'carbonComposition' / 'carbonFilm' — moulded or printed carbon, the commodity rotary material. 'conductivePlastic' — polymer track, long life and low noise. 'wirewound' — resistance wire on a former; high power, stepwise (finite resolution). 'thickFilm' / 'thinFilm' — printed or sputtered film on a substrate.

taperLaw.title: potentiometerTaperLaw
taperLaw.description: Vocabulary of taper laws — how resistance divides between the two track sections as the wiper travels. Referenced by the pinned const in each branch of #/$defs/taper and by the design-requirements side, so the two cannot drift.

taper.title: potentiometerTaper
taper.description: The law relating wiper position to the resistance split. A CLOSED oneOf discriminated by a pinned `law` const: each branch fixes its own law value, so a document lands in exactly one branch and cannot be silently misclassified. Absent means the taper has not been sourced yet — it is NOT an assertion of linearity.

oneOf.title: linearTaper
oneOf.description: Resistance is proportional to wiper position: R_cw = position x totalResistance.

oneOf.title: logarithmicTaper
oneOf.description: Resistance follows an approximately exponential law — the audio/volume taper. `sense` is REQUIRED because the two senses are opposite curves that share the word 'log' on datasheets: getting it wrong inverts the control.

sense.description: 'log' — the standard audio (A) taper: resistance rises slowly over the first part of travel then steeply. 'antiLog' — the reverse-audio (C) taper: steeply first, then slowly.

exponent.description: Optional shape exponent n of the fitted power law R_cw/totalResistance = position^n (dimensionless). n > 1 gives a log sense, n < 1 an antiLog one.

oneOf.title: sShapedTaper
oneOf.description: S-law / W-taper: two mirrored log segments meeting at the centre — fine control at both ends, used for balance and pan controls.

centreResistanceFraction.description: Fraction of totalResistance present between the wiper and the counter-clockwise end at mid-travel (dimensionless, 0..1; 0.5 for a symmetric S).

oneOf.title: customTaper
oneOf.description: Any law the three named ones do not cover, given as measured data. `curve` is REQUIRED — 'custom' without the curve says nothing.

curve.description: Wiper position (x, dimensionless 0..1 of electrical travel) versus resistance fraction R_cw/totalResistance (y, dimensionless 0..1).

wiper.title: potentiometerWiper
wiper.description: The moving contact — the terminal a fixed resistor does not have. Everything here is a property of the contact itself, not of the track.

maximumCurrent.description: Maximum continuous current through the wiper terminal, in A. Usually far below the track's own current capability — the rheostat-connection limit.

contactResistanceVariation.description: Contact resistance variation (CRV) as a fraction of totalResistance (0.03 = 3%) — the noise spec of a moving contact.

actuation.title: potentiometerActuation
actuation.description: How the wiper is moved. A CLOSED oneOf discriminated by a pinned `type` const, because the quantities are not interchangeable: a rotary part has travel in DEGREES and a turns count, a slide part has travel in METRES and no turns at all.

oneOf.title: rotaryActuation
oneOf.description: Wiper driven by a rotating shaft or screw.

turns.description: Number of shaft turns from end stop to end stop (dimensionless). 1 for an ordinary single-turn control, 0.75 for a 270-degree trimmer, 10 for a multiturn trimmer. Equivalent to mechanicalTravel / 360.

mechanicalTravel.description: Total shaft rotation between end stops, IN DEGREES (unit exception — see the schema description).

electricalTravel.description: Rotation over which the wiper is actually on the resistive track, IN DEGREES (unit exception). Always <= mechanicalTravel; the difference is the dead band at the ends.

detents.description: Number of click detent positions over the travel (dimensionless). Absent means a smooth, detentless control.

endStop.description: 'hardStop' — mechanical stops at both ends. 'continuous' — the shaft rotates without limit. 'clutched' — a slip clutch protects the element past the ends (common on multiturn trimmers).

oneOf.title: linearActuation
oneOf.description: Wiper driven along a straight track — slide / fader / linear-motion position sensor.

mechanicalTravel.description: Total slider travel between end stops, in metres.

electricalTravel.description: Travel over which the wiper is on the resistive track, in metres. Always <= mechanicalTravel.

detents.description: Number of click detent positions over the travel (dimensionless).

shaft.title: potentiometerShaft
shaft.description: Shaft / adjuster geometry. Present on every panel-mount and most board-mount rotary parts.

diameter.description: Shaft diameter, in metres (6.35e-3 for a quarter-inch shaft).

length.description: Shaft length beyond the bushing, in metres.

style.description: Shaft end form. 'screwdriverSlot' covers the slotted head of a trimmer with no shaft proper.

material.description: Shaft material as named on the datasheet (e.g. 'brass', 'stainless steel', 'plastic').

datasheetInfo.title: potentiometerDatasheetInfo
datasheetInfo.description: All information extracted from the potentiometer datasheet.

part.title: potentiometerPart
part.description: Basic potentiometer part identification. Extends the PEAS part base by allOf and is sealed with unevaluatedProperties:false (the sanctioned RAS composition idiom), so the base's partNumber / series / case / description are inherited rather than re-declared.

adjustmentAccess.description: Who is expected to turn it. 'userAdjustable' — a front-panel control turned in service. 'trimmer' — set once at manufacture or calibration ('set-and-forget'), typically screwdriver-adjusted.

electrical.title: potentiometerElectrical
electrical.description: Potentiometer electrical characteristics. The headline value is `totalResistance` — the CONSTANT sum of the two track sections either side of the wiper — deliberately NOT named `resistance`, so a fixed-resistor electrical block cannot be renamed into a potentiometer without someone noticing.

totalResistance.description: End-to-end resistance of the track, in Ohm. The two wiper-split sections sum to this value at every wiper position: R_cw + R_ccw = totalResistance.

resistanceTolerance.description: Tolerance on totalResistance as a fraction (0.2 = +/-20%). Potentiometer tolerances are wide because the value is adjusted, not selected.

powerRating.description: Maximum power the whole track may dissipate at the reference temperature, in W. In a rheostat connection only the in-circuit fraction of the track carries current, so the usable rating scales down with wiper position.

powerRatingTemperature.description: Reference temperature for powerRating, in Celsius.

temperatureCoefficient.description: Temperature coefficient of the track resistance, in ppm/K.

maximumWorkingVoltage.description: Maximum continuous voltage across the full track, in V.

insulationResistance.description: Insulation resistance between the element and the case / shaft, in Ohm.

taper.description: How the resistance divides as the wiper moves (see potentiometerTaper).

wiper.description: Properties of the moving contact (see potentiometerWiper).

endResistance.description: Residual resistance between the wiper and the nearer end terminal at full travel, in Ohm — never zero on a real part.

independentLinearity.description: Maximum departure of the measured output from the ideal taper, as a fraction of totalResistance (0.005 = +/-0.5%). The conformity spec of a position sensor.

resolution.description: Smallest achievable resistance step as a fraction of totalResistance. Meaningful for wirewound tracks, which step turn by turn; continuous-track parts have no finite resolution and omit this.

gangs.description: Number of independent resistive sections operated by one actuator (dimensionless). 1 = single, 2 = dual (stereo) — the TE Citec catalogue carries both. Each gang has its own totalResistance and taper; this schema describes them as identical, which is what ganged datasheets specify.

gangTracking.description: Worst-case mismatch between gangs over the electrical travel, as a fraction (0.03 = 3 %, roughly 0.26 dB). Only meaningful when gangs > 1.

mechanical.title: potentiometerMechanical
mechanical.description: Mechanical specs — extends the PEAS mechanical base with the adjuster mechanics a fixed resistor has no room for (shaft, mounting, adjustment side, actuation). It composes the PEAS base directly rather than RAS utils#/$defs/mechanical because that def is SEALED and a sealed subschema cannot be extended; `case`, `pinout` and `landPattern` are therefore re-referenced here (they are $refs to the one PEAS definition, not copies of it).

pinout.description: Per-terminal function map (shared PEAS type). Real for potentiometers: the three terminals are not interchangeable (clockwise end / wiper / counter-clockwise end), and a dual-gang part has six.

landPattern.description: Manufacturer-recommended PCB land pattern (shared PEAS type).

mounting.description: How the body is held. 'panel' — bushing through a panel cut-out. 'board' — mounted on the PCB. 'bushing' — threaded bushing without a panel. 'chassis' — bracket or chassis fixing. 'surfaceMount' — SMD trimmer.

adjustmentSide.description: Face of the body the adjuster is reached from.

terminalOrientation.description: Orientation of the terminals relative to the mounting plane: 'vertical' (axis normal to the board) or 'rightAngle' (axis in the board plane).

actuation.description: How the wiper is moved, and over how much travel (see potentiometerActuation).

rotationalLife.description: Rated mechanical life, in full actuation cycles (dimensionless count).

modelParams.title: potentiometerModelParams
modelParams.description: SPICE model parameters. A potentiometer is emitted as two resistors sharing a wiper node; `wiperPosition` is the DESIGN-TIME FREE VARIABLE that splits rTotal between them, and is a choice made by the design, not a property read off the datasheet.

wiperPosition.description: Fractional wiper position (dimensionless, 0..1) measured from the counter-clockwise / low end. The clockwise section is taper(wiperPosition) x rTotal and the counter-clockwise section is the remainder; the two always sum to rTotal.

rWiper.description: Series wiper contact resistance, in Ohm.

taperExponent.description: Exponent n used to evaluate the taper in the model: R_cw/rTotal = wiperPosition^n. n = 1 reproduces a linear taper.

factors.title: potentiometerFactors
factors.description: Derating factors as functions of temperature.

powerDerating.description: Power derating curve for the whole track.
